scope: ADS eye point for iron sights and optics from game data: MD.Sight.Main on the attachment's MD part record. Checked against 72 aimed in-game iron-sight screenshots taken by the user (1365x768 scaled from 2560x1440, game FOV 103), two of the user's optic recordings and the landmine optic screenshot set.
chain: MD_<W> Class_0653128c (MD part record; Field_5af77230 = 1P bundle name)

-> the record whose Field_b7b33071 imports gamestate fileGuid 4c59b0bd-e1c1-ac8d-4c59-b0bde1c1ac8d (Animations/Glacier/Global/Gamestates/MD.Sight.Main.Vec3); Field_53b7932a -> MD.Sight.Main.QuatGS (identity rotation in every case seen)

-> Field_8cf424e7(.Field_bc4b07b4) translation {x Field_3901db14, y Field_42fc0f5e, z Field_32a99b9c}, metres; weapon space (+z muzzle, +y up) on iron-sight records, the optic's frame on optic records

fieldMeanings.Class_8f378838: Gamestate-keyed transform record in MD files (gamestate import Field_b7b33071, rotation gamestate Field_53b7932a, 4x3 transform Field_8cf424e7)
fieldMeanings.Class_0653128c.Field_eb9379b0: Array of Class_8f378838 refs on an MD part record
fieldMeanings.MD.Sight.Main: ADS eye point. Iron sights: weapon space; z = eye position along the bore; y = eye height (equals the sight-line height on most long guns). Optics: the optic part's frame; one value per optic part on every weapon.
fieldMeanings.WB Class_76a3b0eb referenced by Class_8c: ADS (iron-sight) render record; its Field_7768ebf2 is the iron render FOV

evidenceLevel: Value, Tested (screenshots and recordings). The gamestate name comes from its import path.
rule: Eye z = MD.Sight.Main z of the resolved iron record. Project at the weapon's iron render FOV (vertical) from the blueprint's Class_8cdc5b63 render record: screen px = (H/2) / tan(fov/2) x size / distance.

ironTest.note:
Steps 4-5: file-derived eye rules vs the screenshot measurement (iron-calibration.json), with leave-one-out.
Test set: measurements of good fit quality (confidence high/medium, no edge hit, no visual objection), chosen
without looking at the MD eye. Error = rule eye / measured eye - 1 (the opening px error is the same, inverted).

rules.rule: MD.Sight.Main z (no fitted parameter: leave-one-out = in-sample)
constant distance, LOO median of the others

independentGlobalFit.note: global chamfer fits that never saw the MD eye (shots/fits.json); clean fits only (chamfer < 0.8, eye 95-750 mm). Mk 24, RSPR and ELR-40 were fitted at FOV 55 before the FOV correction

handCheck.note: rear opening widths read by hand from gridded crops (subagents, no predictions shown) for the 15 weapons whose automatic fit failed or was ambiguous, plus NSW4

renderFovCorrections.note: Five weapons had no iron render FOV in frosty-optic-render-fov-2026-09-16.json (1.4.3.0); 55 had been assumed. The ADS record rule reproduces every value that file has, and gives the values below. Each matches the screenshot opening within 2.5%.

yComponent: Long guns: MD y equals the sight-line eye height within 2 mm on 46 of 64; on 18 it is off by -33.6 mm (VSSM) to +17.0 mm (PP-19); the sight line is lower than MD y on some, higher on others. Pistols (GGH-22, M45A1, P18): MD y 53-59 mm below the sight line, while z still gives the right size. The screenshots register with the eye on the sight line and the camera pitched along it (eyeHeight), so MD y is not needed; the drawings use z only.

exceptions.m45a1: eye confirmed by the rear block width; the drawn notch is narrower than in game (the mesh's rear notch is 3.5 mm wide and 2 mm deep in its top silhouette); the front blade taken from the slide is correct (3.2 mm wide)
exceptions.ggh22: eye confirmed (+1%); the drawn rear is the sight mesh only (19 mm wide); the wider in-game block is the slide behind it

optics.result: MD.Sight.Main exists on every optic part record. No optic bundle has two values across the MD files of 14 weapons (134 bundles; shared bundles appear on up to 13 weapons). Eye-to-lens = lens-mesh z - MD z.
optics.landmine: The landmine screenshots (1250x750) match a 1:1 centre crop of a 1440p frame (H/2 = 720, not 375). With that, 16 of 23 optics agree within 5% and 19 within 10%; outliers 3VZR, R-VPS, R4T -15%, 2Pro -13%. Free-fitted scale 1.877 (1440/750 = 1.92).

eyeHeight.finding: The ADS camera looks along the sight line (rear opening to front post tip), not along weapon z. Eye at (0, sight-line height at MD.Sight.Main z, MD z) with pitch = atan(tip height above the eye / eye-to-rear distance), so the front tip sits on screen centre, registers the whole picture (rear, front and surrounding parts) on the screenshots checked. MD y is not needed: it equals that height within 2 mm on 46 of 64 long guns, is off by -33.6 to +17.0 mm on 18 (pitch -1.9 to +2.9 deg, VSSM +4.5), and is 53-59 mm low on three pistols (M45A1, P18, GGH-22; likely another frame). The drawings put the eye on the sight line (make_all.align), so they never used MD y.
eyeHeight.method: proj_all.verify: project the drawing's rear and front from that eye at the iron render FOV over the user's screenshot. Edge-based automatic registration (proj_all.register*) was tried and rejected: hands, rails and blur gave degenerate fits.
eyeHeight.registrationChecked: rows with registrationChecked = true were looked at on overlays (shots/proj/ver*_, item3_, leftovers-sheet.png); the rest are computed only
eyeHeight.columns: eyeYmm = sight-line height at the MD z (drawing's eye); mdYmm = MD.Sight.Main y; diffMm = eyeYmm - mdYmm; pitchDeg = camera pitch

meshSections: Mesh section lists hold a second copy (A,A / A,B,A,B / A,B,C,A,B,C). Take the first half when the second half repeats it (vertex counts within 5%), else every section. Section 1 often holds the other sight: AK4D rear drum; M240L, RPK-74M, RPKM, Z84M front blocks on the barrel; M121 A2 front post. Reading section 0 only left these weapons undrawn (make_all.tris, sec-cmp.json).
socketLead: No: the iron records' Field_20933c0b mesh transforms are identity on every not-drawn weapon (Z84M: z -5 mm only), so they do not place the missing sight parts.
screenshots: The user's iron-sight screenshots moved on 2026-11-17 from BF6 Weapon Analyzer/reference-data/Iron Sights/<class>/<name>.png to reference-data/Optics/<class>/, and were renamed '<in-game name>_Iron_Sights.png' (two-sight files '<name>_<sight>.png'); rename-log.csv in that folder maps the original screenshot names to the current ones. iron-calibration.json 'file' fields hold the current names; scripts match names with case, spaces, '-' and '_' ignored (proj_all.shot_path). The screenshots are the user's own, used for measuring only.
